headline: Why We Exist
problem_body: AI is reshaping every sector of society at an unprecedented pace. Yet access to meaningful AI education remains deeply unequal. Most schools lack trained educators. Existing resources are expensive or inaccessible. Students from low-income and minority communities are disproportionately left out — at risk of becoming passive consumers of AI rather than informed, empowered participants.

steps.title: Open Curriculum
steps.description: We create free, standards-aligned AI learning materials licensed for any school to use.

steps.title: Community Workshops
steps.description: Volunteers deliver hands-on sessions directly in under-resourced communities.

steps.title: Mentorship & Networks
steps.description: Students connect with AI professionals from diverse backgrounds for guidance and opportunity.

steps.title: Policy Advocacy
steps.description: We champion equitable AI literacy policies at district and state levels.

steps.title: Lasting Impact
steps.description: Informed, confident students enter the workforce ready to shape — not just use — AI.
